governed_construct: A variable declaration whose initializer is a Vue template-ref creation call (ref, shallowRef or useTemplateRef from 'vue') whose type argument resolves to the instance type of a Vue component (a default import from a .vue file or a value created with defineComponent), whether written inline as InstanceType<typeof X> or through a type alias.
interpretation: A template ref that will hold a Vue component instance must be bound to a variable whose name ends with 'ComponentRef' (e.g. modalComponentRef). Refs typed as DOM elements (HTMLInputElement, HTMLCanvasElement), plain state refs, and refs holding instances of non-Vue classes (e.g. a chart.js Chart) are not governed. The component-ness of the referenced type is determined by resolving the binding: the typeof target must be a .vue import or a defineComponent result, and type aliases are followed. Names like modalRef, sidebar, editor, player or searchBoxInstance violate; a file with only element or state refs is NOT_APPLICABLE. All-instances semantics: one non-conforming component ref makes the file VIOLATED.
